title: Check the size of a directory
summary: Use `du` to see how much disk space a folder and its contents are using. You can choose human-readable units like MB or GB.

steps.explain: Run `du` with the `-sh` flags to get a single summary line for the directory in human-readable format (e.g., 1.5G).

placeholders.name: DIRECTORY
placeholders.description: The path to the directory you want to check.

alternatives.explain: Show sizes for the directory and all its subdirectories in human-readable format.
